subject: English
passage: Marine biologist Dr. Gina Holden and her team have discovered that nearly 30 percent of the microplastics in deep ocean sediments originate from synthetic clothing fibers. These microscopic polymer strands are released when garments are washed, entering wastewater treatment systems that, after processing and filtration, ______ the particles into nearby rivers and coastal waters.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation:
Choice C is the best answer. "That…[discharge] the particles into nearby rivers and coastal waters" is a relative clause that describes the "wastewater treatment systems." Forming the clause requires a conjugated, finite verb, and this is the only choice that provides that.

Why A is incorrect:

Choice A is incorrect. "To discharge" is an infinitive and can't serve as the main verb of a clause. A conjugated verb is needed here to form the main verb of the relative clause "that…[discharge] the particles into nearby rivers and coastal waters," which describes the "wastewater treatment systems."
